title: Echo of Khiyaanada
intro: Xidhiidh qaraabonimo ayaa lagu tijaabiyay hinaasnimo. Qorshe qarsoodi ah ayaa la sameeyay, kaas oo dhaqaajiyey silsilad dhacdooyin ah oo sannado badan socon doona oo masaafooyin badan dhaafi doona. Ficillada kooxdani waxay horseedeen kala tag iyo murugo qoto dheer, laakiin sheekadu halkaas kuma dhammaan. Waa sheeko khiyaamo, qoomamo, iyo daahfurka ugu dambeeya ee qorshe rabbaani ah. Ma kala furfuri kartaa aqoonsiga shakhsiyaadkan oo doorashadoodu ay jiilal badan ka soo noqnoqotay?
clues: Waxaa na qabsaday xaasidnimo ka dhalatay jacaylka aan u qabno midkeen.
Xasadkeenna awgeed, waxaan si wada jir ah u shirqoolnay oo walaalkeen ku tuurnay mugdiga ceel.
Si aan u qarinno falkeenna, waxaan aabbahay u soo bandhignay dhar, oo dhiig been ah lagu shubay.
Sannado ka dib, macaluul daran ayaa nagu qasabtay inaan u safarno Masar si aan u helno cunto.
Halkaas, waxaan hor nimid guddoomiye awood leh oo, annaga oo aan garanayn, ahaa walaalkii aan dulminay.
Tijaabadii ugu dambeysay waxay ahayd inaan keenno walaalkeen Binyamin, taasoo keentay in la ogaado waayihii hore iyo aabbahay oo ahaa Nabi Yacquub.

trial.label: Maxay ahayd qaladkii ugu weynaa ee aanu galnay?
options: Dhisidda weyl dahab ah oo loogu talagalay cibaadada
Dalbashada inaan si toos ah u arko Allah
Ku jeesjeesaya nebi markuu dhisayay doon
Khiyaamaynta aabbahay iyo ka tagista walaalkeen
trial.answer: Khiyaamaynta aabbahay iyo ka tagista walaalkeen

location.label: Shaygee ayaa udub dhexaad u ahaa khiyaanadayada?
options: Shaadh dhiig been ah lagu rinjiyeeyay
location.answer: Shaadh dhiig been ah lagu rinjiyeeyay

outcome.label: Maxay ahayd natiijada kama dambaysta ah ee sheekadeenna?
options: Waa nala cafiyay oo dib ayaan ula midownay qoyskayagii
outcome.answer: Waa nala cafiyay oo dib ayaan ula midownay qoyskayagii

arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ ءَاثَرَكَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَإِن كُنَّا لَخَـٰطِـِٔينَ
verse: They said, "By Allāh, certainly has Allāh preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners." (12:91)
